notes: Arrange: 小明 completes course 1 (progress 0 -> 20, has_exam 0 -> 1 via the exam) because no seeded enrollment combines has_exam=1 with mark=null. The frozen delta therefore contains the arrange's progress/has_exam update plus the mark update. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written).
